title: A metrically complete and Krull--Schmidt space of multiparameter persistence modules
summary: We show that the observable category of q-tame multiparameter persistence modules satisfies good metric and algebraic properties: it forms a complete metric space with respect to the interleaving distance, and it is Krull--Schmidt in the sense that every object admits an essentially unique decomposition into indecomposables. Moreover, we show that these metric and algebraic structures are compatible: two objects are at distance zero if and only if they are isomorphic.
